description: Take action / take control. Things are as difficult as we make them. #selflove #selfimprovement #communicationskills
transcript: Move on and let go. Move on with grace. Move on in a space of transition, in a space of growth, in a space of nourishment, are not required to hold onto things that are too heavy. It is our responsibility to put baggage down. It is our responsibility to move on. We are not required to stay in the same space, but it requires us to take action.
